mapper.insert: insert into employee (name, sex, no, age, description, department_id) values(#{name}, #{sex}, #{no}, #{age}, #{description}, #{departmentId})
mapper.select:
select id, name, sex, age, no, description, department_id from employee
name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') sex like concat('%', #{sex}, '%') age like concat('%', #{age}, '%') no like concat('%', #{no}, '%') description like concat('%', #{description}, '%') department_id like concat('%', #{departmentId}, '%')
order by department_id asc
mapper.delete: delete from employee where id in #{id}
